Leslie Munce

Preserved Primary Document • munce-l3.htm

Leslie Munce was born in Kent Co., DE on 14 January 1868. He was the son of Isaiah Zaddock Munce and Elmia Carty . Sometime before 1888 he married Margaret Seeney who was born in September 1867. Leslie and Margaret had the following children: Nelson Munce ( July 1888- ) Clarence Munce (Sept. 1889- ) John M. Munce (June 1896- ) Parker Munce Kenneth Munce, married Margaret Pierce
